Closes #1652

Repeated Saturday, Sunday, and holiday lookups previously refetched the same prior trading-day quote on every call. Track successfully fetched windows by normalized ticker and requested date so subsequent lookups reuse the available cached quote.

The first lookup still refreshes a partial cache. Different tickers and later dates refresh independently, and disabling the cache continues to fetch on each successful lookup. Failed, empty, or out-of-window provider responses do not mark a cached window checked, preserving retries after an unusable refresh. Checked dates live only for the adapter instance.

Fractional similar-manager thresholds were accepted on rule creation and update, and persisted thresholds were evaluated as floats. For example, `2.5` could fire against a count of `3`; large integer thresholds could also lose precision.

This uses the existing positive-integer count parser for `similar_manager_count_gte` in validation and evaluation. Invalid stored thresholds do not fire or prevent later valid rules from being evaluated. Integral floats and integer strings retain the existing count-condition behavior. Continuous financial thresholds are unchanged.

- [x] Parse stored thresholds as integers during evaluation.
